entries.title: isalpha
entries.description: Takes a character code (an unsigned char value or EOF) and returns non-zero (true) or 0 (false). Depends on the locale; in the C locale it is ASCII.
mistakes: Passing a negative `char` value: cast it, `(unsigned char) c`.

entries.example: if (islower((unsigned char) c)) c = toupper((unsigned char) c);

entries.title: toupper
entries.summary: Convert a letter to upper case.
entries.description: Returns the upper-case version of a lower-case letter and any other character unchanged. It does not modify strings: apply it to each character.

entries.title: tolower
entries.summary: Convert a letter to lower case.
entries.description: Returns the lower-case version of an upper-case letter and any other character unchanged.
